data.name: Muni Muni BEAM!
data.detailed_description:
A magical girl beat 'em up roguelite where love is your power source.

By day, take classes at the Lunarium Academy, master your elemental powers, and build relationships with the magical girls around you. By night, transform and fight: Classic 2D side-scrolling brawler combat across the moons you're sworn to protect.

MASTER EVERY ELEMENT
Swap elements mid-run, and your entire fighting style changes with it. Fire, water, earth, and wind are only the beginning. Music, mirror and other elements are waiting to be discovered.

RAISE YOUR GEM BUNNIES
Your gem bunnies are where your power comes from. Bond with them, and their element becomes yours in battle. Bring them into the fight at your side, or leave them at home to produce rare ingredients while you're away. Every gem bunny you raise changes what you're capable of.

DEFEND YOUR MOONS
The fights you take and the magical girls who show up to help are different every run. Your actions range from clearing a moon of corruption, fighting off raiders to protect your bunnies and chasing down a wild bunny before it slips into the dark for good.

CRAFT YOUR OWN MAGIC
Between battles, craft crystal essences that boost your magic in battle, made from everything you and your bunnies bring in. Follow a recipe, or experiment and see what you come up with.

YOUR MOON REMEMBERS
Nothing you build here disappears. Your bonds with bunnies and magical girls, and every crystal recipe you learn, all carry over, run after run.
